summary: The report recommends that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) City-owned tree located adjacent to the property at 4 Clovelly Avenue. The application indicates the reasons for removal are that the tree has a poor form, is unsightly and diseased, sheds branches, and leans. The subject tree is a Colorado spruce (Picea pungens), measuring 37 cm in diameter. The Street Tree By-law does not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
decided: City Council on January 31 and February 1, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one (1) City-owned tree located at 4 Clovelly Avenue.
